name: Pane
description: Answer your coding agents from your glasses: Pane's cards, terminals and new Sessions from every computer you pair, over your own Tailscale network.
tagline: Answer your coding agents from your glasses

permissions.description: Hold to talk: your voice goes to your own Pane computer, or to Glassly's speech-to-text when that computer has no speech key.
Pops up a new question from your agents while Pane is behind another miniapp and you're away from your computers.
Holds those pop-ups during a timed meeting, then tells you how many waited.
